checks.finding: The sphere pullback metric is 4/(1+|t|^2)^2 times the two-dimensional identity, hence its area Jacobian is Jomega=4/(1+|t|^2)^2. A joint Lebesgue density g(z,t) becomes g/Jomega in dz dOmega. The target W contains -log(Jomega) only for calibration in dt; final importance weighting in dOmega must not multiply it again.

The Gaussian and the df5,d11 Student joint densities divided by Jomega tend to zero at the omitted south pole for each fixed finite shape. The uniform sphere/expanded-box component stays positive. Every outer-domain CH vector has Cartesian components within[-5,5], while r,s are in[1.2,5] and v in[-1,1], so the proposed box covers the target/audit shape domain. Invalid untruncated Gaussian/Student draws remain zero observations, without redraw.

Reflection of ay,by,ty exactly reflects physical y. Transform the mean and covariance by the same diagonal sign matrix. The final explicit scaled-coordinate map mean_x=x0+S delta, Cx=S Hy^-1 S.T is correct. Use the explicit eigenaxis_order field for transformed unit-Mahalanobis probes, rather than interpreting loose covariance-eigenaxis wording as unscaled Cartesian principal axes.
For nu=5, covariance=nu/(nu-2)*Sigma. Sigma=(12/5)C gives covariance4C. Normalized full joint densities and exact covariance determinants are required for all component terms.

Sum four unconditional chart means once and divide by one entry-chart mean; do not add a symmetry factor or normalize accepted points.
